objective.statement: Establish the authoritative final delivery outcome for ORDER-123 before any duplicate order is considered. Pending or unavailable evidence does not resolve this goal.

criteria.description: An authoritative matching record establishes whether delivery of ORDER-123 definitively succeeded or failed.

authority.content: The caller can read delivery status. Any additional order needs human approval.

constraints.content: Do not submit another order until the first outcome is confirmed.

capabilities.description: Read vendor delivery status using order reference ORDER-123

response_observations.description: Delivery status returned by the vendor for the supplied order; may be pending or inconclusive.

cases.description: An authoritative usable record for ORDER-123 explicitly confirms final successful or failed delivery.
Matching usable record with a non-final business state.
No usable record or definitive negative lookup result.
